package view // import "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/pkg/lang/view"

Package view answers span questions over a lang.Result: which symbol encloses
a line or a line range, which symbols a line range touches, and what bytes a
symbol's span holds in the caller's own source.

Provisional: fields and functions may change in a minor release until the LP-8
readings pass and one release has shipped (CH-D5). The package imports pkg/lang
and the standard library only. Its closure is pkg/lang's plus this package,
so a consumer of view links one package more than a consumer of pkg/lang alone.

A symbol has a known span when EndLine >= Line > 0. A symbol without one
is never guessed: a lookup the Result cannot decide answers StatusUnknown,
and a Touched set says it is incomplete. Nothing here reads a file or adds text
a Result does not already carry, except Slice, which returns the caller's own
bytes to the caller.

FUNCTIONS

func Slice(src []byte, s lang.Symbol) ([]byte, bool)
    Slice returns the bytes of lines s.Line to s.EndLine of src, with their line
    endings, and false when the span is unknown or does not lie inside src.
    It reads nothing but src, and the returned slice shares src's memory.


TYPES

type Index struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Index answers span lookups over one Result. It is immutable after NewIndex
    and safe for concurrent use. The zero Index holds no symbols and reads as
    incomplete: every answer is unknown.

func NewIndex(r lang.Result) *Index
    NewIndex builds the lookup once. It keeps copies of what it needs, so a
    later change to r by the caller changes no answer. Keys are expected to be
    unique within r: two symbols with the same Key and span tie, and which one
    an answer returns then follows the input order.

func (ix *Index) Enclosing(line int) (lang.Symbol, Status)
    Enclosing returns the innermost symbol whose known span holds line. It is
    EnclosingRange(line, line).

func (ix *Index) EnclosingRange(start, end int) (lang.Symbol, Status)
    EnclosingRange returns the innermost symbol whose known span holds every
    line of start..end: the latest Line, then the earliest EndLine, then the
    largest Key (the last symbol in listing order).

    The status is found only when the read is complete, a known span holds the
    whole range, and no symbol with an unknown span could be the innermost:
    none has a Line below 1, or a Line at or after the candidate's Line and
    at or before start. A symbol with an unknown span that starts before the
    candidate's Line can only be outer and does not block found. It is none only
    when the read is complete, no known span holds the range and no symbol with
    an unknown span starts at or before start, a Line below 1 counting as before
    start. Otherwise it is unknown, and the candidate (possibly the zero Symbol)
    is returned as a hint. A Skipped Result, start below 1 and end below start
    are unknown with the zero Symbol.

func (ix *Index) Touched(start, end int) (syms []lang.Symbol, complete bool)
    Touched returns every symbol whose known span intersects start..end, plus
    every symbol with an unknown span whose Line lies in the range, sorted by
    Line, then EndLine descending, then Key. complete is false when the read is
    Incomplete or Skipped, or a symbol with an unknown span starts before start
    (it may have reached into the range). start below 1 and end below start give
    an empty set and false.

type Status string
    Status is the answer class of Enclosing and EnclosingRange.

const (
	// StatusFound: the returned symbol is the innermost one holding the line.
	StatusFound Status = "found"
	// StatusNone: no symbol holds the line, and the Result can say so.
	StatusNone Status = "none"
	// StatusUnknown: the Result cannot decide. The symbol returned, possibly the
	// zero Symbol, is a hint and not an answer.
	StatusUnknown Status = "unknown"
)
    The closed set of Status values.
